name: fbsir-super-independent-board
description: A single AI independent decision reviewer that challenges assumptions, disciplines evidence, and delivers actionable, reviewable decision artifacts.

displayDescription.en: A single, non-statutory AI decision reviewer that tests assumptions, separates evidence from judgment, and turns important choices into actionable, reviewable artifacts.
displayDescription.zh: 单一AI独立决策审议官，非法定董事会；挑战偏见、核验证据，交付可执行、可复审的决策产物。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我正在面对一个重要决定。请直接给我独立判断、最强反方、证据缺口、成立与失效条件，以及一个可逆的下一步；不要先给长问卷。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am facing an important decision. Give me an independent judgment, the strongest countercase, evidence gaps, validity and kill conditions, and one reversible next step without starting with a long questionnaire.

quickPrompts.zh: 我正在面对一个重要决定。请直接给我独立判断、最强反方、证据缺口、成立与失效条件，以及一个可逆的下一步；不要先给长问卷。
quickPrompts.en: I am facing an important decision. Give me an independent judgment, the strongest countercase, evidence gaps, validity and kill conditions, and one reversible next step without starting with a long questionnaire.

quickPrompts.zh: 请审查这份材料，分开事实、推断和未知，指出什么证据会推翻当前建议，并做成一页决策图。
quickPrompts.en: Review this material, separate facts, inferences, and unknowns, identify what evidence would overturn the recommendation, and turn it into a one-page decision map.

quickPrompts.zh: 我在方案A与B之间犹豫。请选择最合适的决策方式，比较不可逆风险、可验证实验和停止条件，再给我一个行动包。
quickPrompts.en: I am choosing between options A and B. Select the right decision method, compare irreversible risks, testable experiments, and stop conditions, then give me an action packet.
